packageRules.description: Renovate's own config:recommended sets semanticCommitType through a packageRule, and packageRules beat top-level config. Setting it at the top level therefore does nothing at all: every upgrade stays chore and cuts no release.

eslint-plugin-oxlint declares a hard `~` peer on the matching oxlint minor, so a lone bump of either resolves to ERESOLVE. The eslint rule above negates the plugin out of its `eslint-plugin-**` matcher so this pairing does not rest on rule order.
